name: Glass Phoenix Aviary
description: An aviary built from transparent glass where phoenix‑like birds of light soar, leaving trails of sparkling embers.
prompt: A vast aviary with walls and ceiling of clear glass. Inside, majestic birds made of pure light and fire soar, their wings leaving trails of sparkling embers that fade slowly. The space glows with warm amber and gold. Cinematic, 8k.
caption: Flight of light, reborn each moment. 🔥🕊️
